---
title: "Aquaculture Resilience Evidence Engine"
format: html
---

AREE re-examines public Pacific oyster RNA-sequencing experiments to help researchers investigate stress responses and potential links to survival, growth or recovery. It checks study designs, estimates gene activity, and records expression differences together with uncertainty and biological limitations.

The [results website](https://sr320.github.io/AREE-co/) presents real study-level findings, evidence cards and downloadable tables. Its counts are calculated from the committed registry and evidence. A separate synthetic demo exercises meta-analysis and candidate scoring. The published website is assembled by `scripts/build_site.py`; this document is an introduction for local documentation browsing.

## Start here

- [Why this matters and what the work involves](why-this-matters.md).
- [Methods and a guide to reading results](methods.md).
- [How expression findings relate to resilience](interpreting-evidence.md).

Expression differences provide clues for follow-up experiments. They do not establish validated predictors of resilience.

## Run the synthetic demo

```bash
aree harmonize-demo
aree meta-analyze --phenotype thermal_tolerance --feature-type gene
aree score-candidates
aree build-evidence-cards
aree build-demo-report
```
